heading: Privacy Policy
introP1: ToyTrader lets you list toys you own and trade them with other users. This page explains what information we collect to run that service, why we collect it, and who we share it with.
collectAccount: Account info from your Google or Facebook sign-in: your email address, display name, and profile picture.
collectContent: Content you create: toy listings (title, photos, and an optional video), trade offers, ratings you leave, and any help/complaint reports you submit (including optional photo evidence).
collectShipping: Shipping details you choose to share with a trade partner once a trade is accepted: your name, phone number, and chosen parcel-machine location.
collectPayment: Payment confirmation if you pay the optional tip - Stripe processes your card details directly and we never see or store your card number, only a payment confirmation reference.
collectDevice: Basic usage analytics, and a push-notification device token if you choose to enable notifications.
collectLocation: Your device's precise location, only if you tap "Use my location" to find the nearest parcel machine - this is processed entirely on your device to compute distances and is never sent to our servers or stored anywhere.
useP1: We use this information to operate the trading service: showing toy listings, matching and tracking trade offers, letting you message and rate trade partners, sending shipping-status emails and notifications you've opted into, responding to help requests, and moderating abuse (for example, disabling an account that repeatedly violates our rules).
shareTradePartner: Your shipping name, phone number, and parcel-machine choice are shown only to the specific trade partner you're shipping to, once a trade is accepted.
shareProviders: Google/Firebase, which hosts our database, authentication, file storage, and analytics.
shareStripe: Stripe, only if you pay the optional tip - they process the payment, we don't.
shareOmniva: Omniva: we don't send your data to Omniva automatically. If you ship a toy, you register the parcel yourself directly on Omniva's own site and paste the resulting tracking barcode into ToyTrader - your shipping details only reach Omniva if and when you enter them there.
noSale: We don't sell your personal data to anyone.
retentionP1: We keep your account and trade data for as long as your account is active, so you can see your trade history. If a listing or account is removed (by you or by moderation), it stops appearing in the app; some records may be kept briefly afterward for abuse-prevention purposes.
rightsP1: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data, object to or restrict certain processing, and request a copy of your data. You can also lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority. To exercise any of these rights, contact us using the details below.
childrenP1: ToyTrader isn't directed at children, and we don't knowingly collect personal data from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, please contact us and we'll remove it.
securityP1: We rely on Google Firebase's security infrastructure to protect your data, including access controls on who can read or write it. No method of storage or transmission is ever 100% secure, but we take reasonable steps to protect your information.
changesP1: We may update this policy as the app changes. We'll update the date at the top of this page when we do.
contactP1: For any question or request about your personal data, email us at <EmailLink>toytrader27@gmail.com</EmailLink>.
